decisions.reason: As a close-to-core API that remained actively marketed from 2023 to 2024, it likely has low continuation cost on the existing cloud platform and still offers option value as part of the firm's integrated messaging portfolio.

Because this adjacent gateway was only launched in 2024 and fits the firm's established secure communication stack, management would keep the option open while market uptake and cross-selling potential are still being learned at limited incremental cost.

This newly launched 2024 product is also a low-distance extension of the firm's core messaging capabilities, so under real options logic it should be retained until more evidence arrives on demand and synergy within enterprise workflows.
